**Whales** are creatures found in Appalachia.

Creatures that are found in the Aquarium of the Atlantic. Several are found deceased, whereas others can be seen swimming in tanks. There was a Beluga Whale Exhibit featuring Mary and Marty. The remains of the creatures can also be found by Vault Dwellers. In addition, several large whale skeletons are found throughout the region. Munch wrote a memoir mentioning whales, entitled A Whale of a Tale.

In Atlantic City, there are deceased Beluga Whales.

Whale corpses would explode until the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.

Whale remains appear in *Fallout 76*.
